title: ProviderObstruction v1 (DRAFT / CANDIDATE)
$comment: STATUS: DRAFT/CANDIDATE — non-binding until ratified. This schema exports names for existing AG law; it does not create a new authority surface. An obstruction is honest reporting that a provider could not proceed. It is NOT a downgrade path and NOT an AG verdict. Shape reserved by plan-envelope-v0 §5. See docs/api/provider-integration.md.

blocked_step.$comment: projects from: plan-envelope-v0 steps — which advisory step could not proceed.

refusal_class.$comment: CLOSED vocabulary (no per-provider taxonomies). First five REUSE plan-envelope-v0's refusal classes verbatim (a passed-through plan/governance refusal); the remaining four are a small closed provider-side obstruction set defined by this surface. Raw provider detail goes in refusal_verbatim, never here.

refusal_verbatim.$comment: The refusal, carried verbatim. AG's own refusals pass through unchanged; a provider never rewrites them into something softer.

what_must_change.description: What upstream must change for the work to become admissible. Advisory; not a demand, not authority.

suggested_next.$comment: Advisory routing only. AG decides; a suggestion is never a dispatch.
